inputs.52.text: Modern flat-colour anime illustration in the style of a cute mobile-game mascot key visual: bold, clean dark outlines of even weight, bright flat cel colours filled edge to edge, one simple step of soft lavender shading, crisp edges everywhere. An empty school hallway after school, seen at standing eye height from a three-quarter angle down its length. On the left wall, a large cork bulletin board in a light wood frame, covered with club notices and printed handouts held by coloured push pins. On the right, a long row of tall windows with rain running down the glass and a soft white rainy sky outside, their light reflecting as pale stripes on the polished pale grey floor. The hallway runs away toward a far door in the centre. Off-white walls with a pale violet stripe along the lower wall. White, pale grey and violet with small touches of sunflower yellow on the notices. Soft, cool, even rainy daylight from the windows on the right.
